content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

The architecture behind selling music online without relying on restricted platforms is built on decentralized principles. It’s about creating a system that empowers creators by providing full control over their sales process. By using a combination of cloud infrastructure and crypto payment solutions, you eliminate the need for third-party payment processors that charge exorbitant fees, allowing you to retain more revenue from each sale.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture utilizes GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store, where you can showcase your music. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers serve as the backend logic to facilitate order processing. With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies for immediate payment verification, ensuring that transactions are seamless and cost-effective. This stack is designed to be operationally efficient, allowing for automated delivery of your music files immediately after payment.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is specifically crafted for digital creators in regions where traditional payment platforms are inaccessible or overly restrictive. Whether you are a musician selling beats, a producer sharing presets, or an educator offering courses, this sovereign stack provides the tools necessary to establish a successful online store. It empowers you to bypass barriers that limit your potential, allowing you to focus on what matters most—your content.
Retain more revenue by reducing transaction fees with NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The system is comprised of several key components: hosting through GitHub or Cloudflare, backend processing with Google Apps Script or Workers, an order management solution like Supabase, and file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Each component integrates seamlessly with NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This architecture not only ensures reliability but also guarantees that you own all your data and assets post-deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose your hosting solution—GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Load your products, configure your order management system, and ensure your file delivery method is ready. Finally, launch your store and start selling your music directly to your audience without the burden of high fees.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe by establishing your own digital store using free hosting solutions like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Utilizing NOWPayments allows you to accept cryptocurrency, bypassing the need for traditional payment processors. This method not only eliminates fees but also gives you complete ownership of your sales.
Own your digital commerce stack—no subscriptions, no third-party dependencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell eBooks or other digital products without being hindered by platform fees, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197). This kit provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to build your own sovereign digital commerce stack. For further details, visit https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

You can create your own online store using free hosting platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Integrate NOWPayments to accept cryptocurrency payments, eliminating the reliance on PayPal or Stripe.

Utilizing a combination of free hosting, backend processing, and NOWPayments allows you to sell digital downloads without incurring high platform fees like those from Gumroad.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By building your own online store infrastructure, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your customers, retaining complete control and ownership of your transactions.
How does NOWPayments compare to traditional payment platforms?
NOWPayments charges only a 0.5% fee compared to platforms like Gumroad, which takes 10%. This significant difference means you retain more revenue from each sale.
What are the benefits of using a sovereign digital commerce stack?
A sovereign stack gives you full ownership of your data, eliminates ongoing subscription fees, and allows you to operate without being dependent on third-party services.
